solutions.title: Dynamic programming over predecessors
solutions.strategy: For each destination index, scan earlier indices that can reach it and keep the smallest predecessor jump count.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every pair of earlier index and destination may be checked in the nested loops.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP array stores the minimum jump count for every index.

solutions.title: Greedy jump ranges
solutions.strategy: Treat each jump as covering a range, track the farthest next range, and increment the answer when the current range ends.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index before the target is visited once while extending the next reachable range.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only range boundaries and the jump count are stored.
